issue.title: Add the orientation lock to native settings
issue.body:
**What:** Port the Portrait / Landscape / Auto orientation picker and confirm the canvas behaves on rotation.

**Where:** Svelte `settings/OrientationPicker.svelte`, `docs/ORIENTATION.md`; RN `drawing/PaperWorkspace.tsx`.

**Done when:** each setting locks or frees rotation on Android and iPad, and rotating mid-drawing keeps the picture intact.

Part of #2690.
issue.display_title: Add the orientation lock to native settings

comments.body: Done in #2776 (merged into `codex/native-migration`): Portrait/Landscape/Auto orientation setting with the shipping copy and per-device rules, applied through expo-screen-orientation on native and the fullscreen gate on web.
